project_meta.title: What If the World Never Invented Plastic?

global_style.art_style: Minimalist hand-drawn stickman explainer animation, warm off-white paper background, bold slightly imperfect black ink outlines, limited earthy accent colors, uncluttered compositions, expressive body language, simple readable props, dynamic visual storytelling. CRITICAL CHARACTER EYE DESIGN: Every stickman must have exactly two tiny, simple, solid-black dot or small oval eyes. Eyes must be completely filled black shapes with no pupils, no irises, no highlights, no reflections, no eye whites, no eyelashes, no detailed anatomy and no realistic features. Keep the exact same cute, simple dot-eye design in every single image. The recurring presenter has a round white face, two tiny solid-black dot eyes, a simple curved mouth, thin black stick limbs and a small red bow tie. Maintain identical face proportions and eye design throughout.
global_style.negative_prompt: Detailed eyes, realistic eyes, visible pupils, irises, eye highlights, eye reflections, eye whites, eyelashes, eyebrows with realistic detail, human anatomy, photorealism, 3D rendering, inconsistent character faces, different eye styles, extra limbs, distorted hands, cluttered backgrounds, excessive text, watermarks, logos, overly bright colors.

presenter.label: Recurring Stickman Presenter
presenter.visual_dna: A cute minimalist hand-drawn stickman with a perfectly round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes with absolutely no pupils, irises, highlights or eye details, a simple curved black mouth, thin black stick arms and legs, and a small red bow tie. The eyes must always look like two simple filled black dots. Identical face shape, eye size, spacing and proportions in every appearance.

shopkeeper.label: Old World Shopkeeper
shopkeeper.visual_dna: A minimalist hand-drawn stickman shopkeeper with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, a simple curved mouth, thin black limbs and a small brown apron. Same simple cute eye style as the presenter.

customer.label: Customer
customer.visual_dna: A minimalist hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils, irises or highlights, a simple curved mouth, thin black limbs and a small blue scarf. Same simple cute eye style as the presenter.

old_market.label: Traditional Market
old_market.visual_dna: A charming old-fashioned marketplace with wooden stalls, glass jars, paper bags, cloth sacks, metal containers, baskets and handwritten signs. Warm earthy colors, hand-drawn outlines and a nostalgic atmosphere.

paper_packaging.label: Paper Packaging Workshop
paper_packaging.visual_dna: A traditional packaging workshop with brown paper sheets, cardboard boxes, paper rolls, starch-based glue, wooden tools and twine. Warm off-white and earthy tones.

glass_factory.label: Glassmaking Workshop
glass_factory.visual_dna: A traditional glass workshop with a furnace, glowing molten glass, glass bottles, jars and skilled workers using long metal tools. Warm orange light and hand-drawn industrial details.

metal_factory.label: Metal Packaging Workshop
metal_factory.visual_dna: A traditional metalworking workshop with tin containers, steel cans, metal sheets, hand tools and a small furnace. Industrial but clean, with muted grey and earthy colors.

natural_materials.label: Natural Materials Workshop
natural_materials.visual_dna: A workshop filled with woven cloth, jute, cotton, natural rubber, wooden containers, baskets, rope and plant-based materials. Warm organic colors and simple handmade details.

beats.narration_text: एक पल के लिए सोचो... अगर इंसानों ने कभी प्लास्टिक बनाया ही नहीं होता, तो हमारी दुनिया कैसी दिखती?

Warm off-white paper texture, bold imperfect black ink outlines, earthy accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
